_comment: The follow camera (refit phase 2). Pixels, seconds and per-second rates; the view is 400x240.
_keep_in: The hard zone: however fast she moves, her centre stays at least this far inside the view's edges (the smoothing alone let a thermal carry her out of frame).
_wake: Ordinary enemies (src/enemies/wake_rule.gd): a despawned enemy respawns when its spawn comes within the view grown by enemy_wake_margin_px; an awake one despawns once its body is further out than enemy_sleep_margin_px.
_arena: Boss arenas: the camera locks when Kaya's centre enters the arena, eases into it over arena_ease_s, and lets go once she is arena_release_px clear of it.
